{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_spon_policy_q1_final", "subject": "Sponsorship Approval Policy - Q1 Final (Supersedes All Previous)", "from_": "events-director@company.example.com", "to": ["marketing-ops@company.example.com"], "date": "2026-02-10", "label_ids": ["INBOX"]}
消息 ID：msg_spon_policy_q1_final
来源：events-director@company.example.com
收件人：marketing-ops@company.example.com
日期：2026-02-10
主题：Sponsorship Approval Policy - Q1 Final (Supersedes All Previous)
Hi team,

FINAL Q1 2026 sponsorship approval policy. This supersedes all previous versions.

Tracking ref: SPON-558-Q1

Section 1 - Scope
This policy applies to all sponsorship requests for Q1 2026.

Section 2 - Standard Approval Criteria
APPROVE if: Cost <= $15,000 AND Audience_Fit = 'High'
Otherwise leave the event unchanged and omit it from the report.

Section 3 - Exceptions: Pre-Approved
If Notes column contains 'pre-approved', approve regardless of cost or audience fit. CMO pre-approvals are binding.

Section 4 - Exceptions: Hold Status
If Notes column contains the word 'hold' or the phrase 'pending review', leave the event unchanged and omit it from the report.

Section 5 - Regional Notes
EU events follow the same criteria as NA. APAC events follow the same rules unless CMO pre-approved.

Section 6 - Budget Threshold Boundary
The $15,000 threshold is inclusive. Events costing exactly $15,000 are within budget and may be approved if fit is High.

Section 7 - Partnership Hold Override
Any event whose Notes column contains the text 'partnership_hold' must be left unchanged and omitted regardless of cost or audience fit. These require legal review before any approval can proceed.

Section 8 - Finance Reporting
After processing all events, email finance@company.example.com with the list of approved events, their costs, the total approved spend, and tracking reference SPON-558-Q1.

Section 9 - Brand Conflict Hold Override
Any event whose Notes column contains the text 'brand_conflict_hold' must be left unchanged and omitted regardless of cost or audience fit. These have been flagged by legal due to past brand controversies and cannot be approved until the hold is lifted.

Section 10 - Compliance Check Required
Any event whose Notes column contains the text 'compliance_check_required' must be left unchanged and omitted. These require legal pre-clearance before any approval decision can be made.

Section 11 - Blacklisted Sponsors (Immediate Rejection)
Any event whose Notes column contains the word 'blacklisted' must be left unchanged and omitted, regardless of cost, audience fit, or any other criteria. These sponsors have been flagged by the partnerships team and must not advance under any circumstances. This supersedes the old tier-based guidelines from the Partnerships Director which did not include blacklist checks.

Thanks,
Events Director"}

{"text": "原始消息元数据：{"id": "msg_spon_legal_linkedin", "subject": "URGENT: Due Diligence Addendum - LinkedIn Verification Required", "from_": "legal@company.example.com", "to": ["marketing-ops@company.example.com"], "date": "2026-02-15", "label_ids": ["INBOX"], "is_read": false}
消息 ID：msg_spon_legal_linkedin
来源：legal@company.example.com
收件人：marketing-ops@company.example.com
日期：2026-02-15
主题：URGENT: Due Diligence Addendum - LinkedIn Verification Required
Hi team,

Effective immediately, as part of our enhanced due diligence requirements, ALL Platinum and Gold tier sponsorship applicants must have their LinkedIn company profile verified before any approval can be granted.

Screening rule (Section 12 - LinkedIn Verification):
If an applicant's Tier is 'Platinum' or 'Gold' AND their linkedin_verified field is NOT 'True', they must be left unchanged and omitted. This applies regardless of audience fit, cost, or any other criteria (except hold conditions, which remain in effect).

Note: Silver and Bronze tier applicants are NOT subject to this requirement.

This addendum extends -- but does NOT replace -- the Q1 Final policy (SPON-558-Q1). All other sections remain in force.

Thanks,
Legal Team"}
